input_file.description: Path to the input file. If empty or '-', reads from stdin.

output_file.description: Path to the output file. If empty, writes to stdout.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for errors. If empty, writes to stderr.

pagesize.description: Page size for buffering STDIN in bytes.

single_addr.description: Hex offset to disassemble a single instruction (e.g., '0x100').

entry_addr.description: Hex offset to start disassembling forward from.

range_start.description: Hex offset to start disassembling a range from.

range_len.description: Length (hex) of the range to disassemble. 0 means to end of file.
